name: Fregerilla
source:
The wife of [url=/c105726]Meliagris[/url] the landlord, mother of [url=/c105727]Pterios[/url], adoptive mother of [url=/c105728]Corelle[/url]. 

Frey has a jealous personality and she constantly wants to get rid of all the young maids in their house. But after she is impressed by [url=/c105719]Pristella Calnart[/url]'s gentle, obedient and pure personality, Frey promises that she would never touch the maids as long as Stella stays as loyal as she is. And for now that promise is kept. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040816084928/http://active-soft.jp/catalog/lostmind.html]official website[/url].]
